name: memori
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code. Recalls what you have told Memori before each prompt and sends each finished turn back to be remembered.

identity_token.title: Identity token
identity_token.description: Memori identity token (starts with id_). Sent as the bearer token.

api_header_value.title: Client API key
api_header_value.description: Memori client API key, sent as the X-Memori-API-Key header.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of the Memori API for your deployment.

entity_id.title: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Who these memories are about. Required: a captured turn with no entity produces no memories. Use the same value in every Memori client.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Write hook activity to stderr, visible with --debug-file.
